title: Co-Star Real Estate Scraper
description:
CoStar Real Estate Scraper is designed to scrape publicly available commercial real estate data from [CoStar's website](https://www.costar.com/). It automates the extraction of key property and market details for further analysis, research, or integration with your data pipelines.

## Features

- **Automated Scraping:** Navigate through CoStar's public pages to extract commercial property listings and market data.
- **Pagination & Navigation Handling:** Automatically process multiple pages or sections to ensure comprehensive data collection.
- **Flexible Output:** Export scraped data to structured formats such as JSON, CSV, or directly into a database.
- **Configurable Extraction:** Easily adjust or extend the set of data fields to capture additional details as needed.

## Data Extracted

Depending on the publicly available content, the scraper aims to extract the following information for each listing or data entry:

- **Property Information:**
  - **Property Name:** The title or name of the property.
  - **Address & Location:** Detailed address information and geographic coordinates, if available.
  - **Property Type:** Classification (e.g., Office, Retail, Industrial, Multifamily).
  - **Square Footage/Area:** Total leasable or rentable space.
  - **Listing Status:** Current status such as Available, Under Lease, or Sold.
  - **Price/Lease Rate:** Financial details including sale price or rental rates.
  - **Images/Media:** URLs for any associated images or media assets.
  - **Property Description:** A brief summary of features, amenities, and unique selling points.

- **Market & Additional Data:**
  - **Market Trends:** Information on regional or local market conditions (if available).
  - **Tenant Details:** Major tenants or occupancy data (subject to public disclosure).
  - **Listing URL/ID:** Unique identifier and direct link to the full listing or detail page.
  
*Note:* The actual fields available may vary based on the specific sections of the website and user access rights.

title: Mx lookup API
description:

>You can wrap existing solution, e.g. [Eightify](https://eightify.app/).

The YouTube AI summarizer is designed to transform how users interact with video content by providing concise summaries of videos, saving users valuable time. By utilizing advanced algorithms, this tool processes both audio and text elements to extract key ideas, allowing users to grasp essential information without watching the entire video.

## Key features
- **Instant summaries**: Extracts key points directly within YouTube, providing users with quick access to the most important information.
- **Smart navigation**: Offers timestamped summaries, enabling users to jump to specific topics of interest.
- **Top comment overview**: Analyzes video comments to provide a consensus on viewer opinions and assess content value.
- **Superior transcription**: Provides video-to-text transcription capabilities that surpass YouTube's built-in subtitles.
- **Multilingual support**: Offers summaries and translations in over 40 languages, making it accessible to a global audience.
- **Easy sharing**: Converts summaries into shareable articles with a single click.
- **Versatile content handling**: Supports videos of any length, from short clips to multi-hour lectures, and works with various content formats including podcasts and news videos.
- **Cross-platform accessibility**: Available as a browser extension for desktop and as dedicated apps for mobile devices.

## Target audience
This tool is ideal for busy professionals who need to evaluate content quickly, students creating notes and cheat sheets, content creators streamlining their research process, educators preparing lessons, journalists extracting information for news, and casual viewers looking to maximize their content consumption efficiency.

title: Amazon MCP
description:
The Amazon MCP Actor provides a model context protocol (MCP) server implementation that enables AI assistants and language models to interact with Amazon's vast e-commerce ecosystem through structured data access. This Actor establishes a standardized interface allowing AI systems to retrieve product information, pricing data, reviews, and seller details from Amazon while maintaining compliance with platform guidelines.

## Key features
- **Real-time product search and data extraction**: Delivers comprehensive product details including specifications, images, and availability status.
- **Automated price monitoring and comparison tools**: Tracks product pricing across different sellers and time periods.
- **Review sentiment analysis and aggregation**: Processes customer feedback to provide insights into product quality and satisfaction.
- **Structured data export**: Supports multiple formats including JSON, CSV, and XML for integration with existing workflows.

## Target audience
This Actor is designed for AI developers building e-commerce assistants, market research professionals analyzing consumer trends, competitive intelligence teams monitoring product landscapes, and businesses developing price comparison or recommendation systems.

## Benefits
- Accelerates development of Amazon-integrated AI applications.
- Reduces complexity in accessing Amazon's data through standardized MCP protocols.
- Enhances decision-making capabilities through structured product intelligence.
- Improves efficiency in building scalable e-commerce automation solutions adaptable to changing market conditions.

title: Trump AI voice generator
description:
The Trump AI voice generator Actor creates realistic audio content by synthesizing speech in the distinctive style and vocal patterns of Donald Trump. This Actor processes text input to generate high-quality audio files that mimic Trump's characteristic speaking manner, intonation, and delivery style.

## Key features
- **Advanced neural voice synthesis**: Captures unique vocal characteristics of Donald Trump.
- **Customizable speech parameters**: Allows adjustments in speed and emphasis.
- **Batch processing capabilities**: Handles multiple text inputs simultaneously.
- **Export options**: Provides various audio formats including MP3 and WAV.

## Target audience
This Actor is perfect for content creators, podcasters, and social media influencers who need engaging audio content. It's also ideal for political satirists and comedy writers developing parody material, marketing professionals creating attention-grabbing campaigns, and developers building entertainment applications or chatbots.

## Benefits
- **Time-saving automation**: Streamlines content production.
- **Cost-effective alternative**: Eliminates the need for hiring voice actors.
- **Consistent voice quality**: Ensures uniformity across all generated content.
- **Scalable processing**: Manages large volumes of text efficiently.

Users can quickly produce professional-quality audio content for entertainment, educational, or commercial purposes while maintaining the distinctive vocal characteristics that make the content instantly recognizable and engaging for their audiences.

title: n8n MCP
description:
The n8n mcp actor creates a bridge between the n8n workflow automation platform and model context protocol (MCP) servers, enabling the integration of AI models with automated workflows. This actor connects to MCP servers and translates n8n workflow data into MCP-compatible formats, allowing users to incorporate AI capabilities directly into their automation processes.

## Key features
- Automatic MCP server discovery and connection management
- Real-time data transformation between n8n and MCP protocols
- Support for multiple concurrent MCP sessions
- Comprehensive error handling with retry mechanisms for reliable workflow execution

## Target audience
This actor is designed for workflow automation specialists, AI developers, DevOps engineers, and technical teams looking to enhance their n8n workflows with AI-driven decision making and data processing. It simplifies the integration of AI models into existing workflows, reduces development time for AI-enhanced automation projects, and provides a standardized way to access various AI services through MCP. Non-technical users can also benefit by accessing AI capabilities without needing deep programming knowledge, making AI-powered workflow automation accessible across organizations.

title: Brave search API
description:
The Brave Search API Actor automates web search operations using Brave's privacy-focused search engine. It allows users to programmatically retrieve search results without tracking or data collection. The Actor integrates with Brave's Search API to perform queries and extract structured data from search results, including titles, descriptions, URLs, and metadata.

## Key features
- **Bulk search processing**: Handle multiple queries simultaneously.
- **Customizable result filtering**: Apply pagination controls and various search parameters like location and time filters.
- **Automated data export**: Export data in multiple formats, including JSON, CSV, and Excel.
- **Advanced scraping capabilities**: Extract additional details from search result pages as needed.

## Target audience
This Actor is ideal for:
- **SEO professionals**: Conduct keyword research and competitor analysis.
- **Market researchers**: Gather industry insights and trends.
- **Data scientists**: Collect large-scale web data.
- **Content creators**: Find topic inspiration and identify trends.
- **Businesses**: Monitor online presence and brand mentions.

## Benefits
- **Enhanced privacy protection**: Compared to traditional search APIs.
- **Time savings**: Through automated bulk processing.
- **Reliable data extraction**: With structured outputs.
- **Cost-effective**: An alternative to premium search tools.
- **Integration**: Works with existing Apify workflows and data pipelines for comprehensive web scraping and analysis projects.

title: PDF to text API
description:
Converting PDF documents into machine-readable text is now easier with the PDF to text API Actor. This tool processes uploaded PDF files, extracting all textual content while preserving the document's structure and formatting wherever possible.

## Key features
- **Batch processing**: Handle multiple PDFs simultaneously, saving time and effort.
- **Password protection**: Supports password-protected and encrypted PDF files.
- **Optical character recognition (OCR)**: Extracts text from scanned documents and image-based PDFs.
- **Flexible output formats**: Offers plain text, JSON, and structured data with metadata extraction.

## Target audience
This Actor is perfect for developers building document management systems, data analysts extracting information from PDF reports, content creators needing text extraction for research, and businesses automating document workflows for compliance or archival purposes.

## Benefits
- Eliminates manual copy-paste processes.
- Enables automated content analysis and searchability of PDF archives.
- Reduces processing time from hours to minutes for large document batches.
- Integrates easily into existing applications through RESTful API endpoints.

Designed to scale efficiently, this solution handles enterprise-level document processing needs while maintaining high accuracy in text extraction. It's an invaluable tool for any organization dealing with substantial PDF document volumes.

title: Yellow Pages API
description:
The Yellow Pages API Actor is designed to extract comprehensive business data from Yellow Pages directories, allowing users to efficiently gather contact information, business details, and location data on a large scale. This Actor systematically crawls Yellow Pages listings based on search criteria such as business categories, geographic locations, or specific keywords, and then structures the extracted data into clean, usable formats.

## Key features
- **Automated data extraction**: Extracts business names, addresses, phone numbers, websites, and operating hours.
- **Advanced filtering options**: Target specific industries or regions with precision.
- **Bulk data export**: Export data in multiple formats like CSV, JSON, or Excel.
- **Real-time data validation**: Ensures accuracy and completeness of the extracted information.

## Target audience
This Actor is ideal for sales teams building prospect databases, marketing agencies conducting market research, business development professionals identifying potential partners or competitors, data analysts studying market trends, and entrepreneurs researching local business landscapes.

## Benefits
- **Time-saving**: Reduces manual research time from hours to minutes.
- **Access to verified contacts**: Provides thousands of verified business contacts that are difficult to collect manually.
- **Cost-effective lead generation**: Offers a more affordable alternative to expensive business directory subscriptions.
- **Informed decision making**: Facilitates strategic decisions through comprehensive market insights, helping businesses build stronger sales pipelines.

title: News API India
description:
The News API India actor is a specialized web scraping tool designed to collect and aggregate news content from major Indian news sources and publications. This actor systematically crawls through popular Indian news websites, extracting article headlines, content, publication dates, sources, and categories. It then structures this data into a clean, accessible format through API endpoints.

## Key features
- Real-time news extraction from multiple Indian news sources, including Hindi and English publications.
- Automatic categorization by topics such as politics, business, sports, entertainment, and regional news.
- Customizable filtering options by date range, source, language, or specific keywords.
- Structured JSON output with comprehensive metadata for each news article.

## Target audience
This actor is ideal for news aggregators, media monitoring companies, research institutions studying the Indian media landscape, mobile app developers building news applications, content creators seeking trending topics, and businesses requiring market intelligence from Indian news sources.

## Benefits
- Provides centralized access to diverse Indian news content without manually visiting multiple websites.
- Enables automated news monitoring and analysis, saving significant time in news research and content curation.
- Offers real-time updates on breaking news and trending stories.
- Delivers consistent data format that integrates easily with existing applications and analytics tools for comprehensive media monitoring solutions.
